name: Musashi Seimitsu Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Musashi Seimitsu Industry Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive parts in Japan, the United States, Asia, China, and Europe. The company's power train business offers differential mechanism products comprising differential assembly and gear; decelerating mechanisms, including planetary assemblies; engine intake and exhaust mechanisms, such as cast and assembled camshafts, and balance shafts; and shift gear mechanisms comprising transmission gears. Its linkage and suspension business provides connecting, absorbing, and steering transmission mechanisms comprising suspension arm assemblies, and suspension and steering ball joints.
